runs.name: Fujitsu Limited
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **¥4,250** (TSE 6702, close 2026-10-09; Tokyo shut 2026-10-12; the intraday ¥4,172 of 2026-10-13 not used) and ADR **$26.93** (OTC close 2026-10-12), aggregator, flagged; **1 ADS = 1 share** on Citibank's Corporate Action Announcement of 2024-02-15 (ratio 1:5 to 1:1, unsponsored, matching the 10-for-1 split of 2024-04-01), checked from the two quotes at 158.06. Shares **1,734,777,285** (issued 1,739,778,265 less treasury 5,000,980 at 2026-06-30, Q1 results of 2026-07-30; cross-checked to Note 18 at March 2026; 331,330 thousand treasury shares cancelled in the year; the buyback authorised 2026-04-28 for up to 100 million shares or ¥150bn shows no purchases by June 30) = cap **¥7,372.8bn** (about $46.6bn); sovereign **4.085%** (JGB 30Y, Ministry of Finance jgbcme.csv, 2026-10-09). Not an SEC registrant (the dispatcher's EDGAR search found no Fujitsu 20-F; `cover_shares.py` 'NOT AN SEC REGISTRANT'): every figure by hand from the company's Integrated Report Financial Sections 2026, 2024, 2022 and 2020, the FY2025 results and Q&A of 2026-04-28 and the Q1 results of 2026-07-30. Not obtained: the Integrated Report 2025 and 2024 main volumes and the 2025 Financial Section (HTTP 429 then 404), the yuho on EDINET, the AGM notice; the Item 1A equivalent therefore taken from the releases' risk list, Note 39 and the Q&A, a gap stated. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the Financial Section's Management's Analysis and segment note, as the overnight brief directs. In the window, named by the analyst: Device Solutions discontinued (FDK tendered to SILITECH March 2025; SHINKO's 50.02% transferred 2025-06-11, gain ¥141.5bn), Fujitsu Optical Components to Furukawa Electric 2025-04-01, the 44% Fujitsu General stake sold August 2025 (gain ¥40.0bn), servers and storage into Fsas Technologies and network products into 1FINITY (July 2025), BrainPad bought for ¥48.8bn cash (December 2025), segments re-cut twice. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)** on the deciding part: Service Solutions at 83% of five-year consolidated adjusted operating profit (¥1,168.6bn of ¥1,406.2bn, FY3/2022-26), Regions (Japan) ¥293.9bn of the segment's ¥361.4bn in FY3/2026; its ten-year economics turn on how generative AI changes the man-hour model of Japanese system integration (the company: 'moving away from the traditional man-hour based business revenue structure'), and the CEO said on 2026-04-28 'it is difficult to picture what sort of technologies will exist 10 years from now', that the 'death of existing applications' could occur and that 'customers are bringing more work inhouse'; modernization (11% of segment revenue) 'will peak in 2028 or 2029'. Test 7 (customers, not technology) set down against and not found to fix the earning power. Q2 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, recorded not weighed: Service Solutions margin 6.0% (FY3/2021) to 15.4% (FY3/2026), untested by a downturn, the CFO saying the offshoring gains 'are starting to level off'; restructuring adjustments every year (¥116bn, ¥42bn, ¥42bn); buybacks at an average ¥3,926 with no price limit; **integrity facts recorded, not judged**: the UK Post Office Horizon inquiry, an unquantified contingency (Note 39). COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash, continuing operations, after all capital spending, all lease payments, acquisitions and stock pay, FY3/2022-26 all-equity ¥-8.3, -26.0, 44.6, 92.1, 148.5bn, average **¥50.2bn** (equity basis ¥59.2bn); Device Solutions' cash before 2025 estimated from segment notes at an assumed 30% tax (a CONVENTION of this run); sale proceeds of whole businesses left out (a CONVENTION of this run; the literal series crediting them averages ¥150.8bn, shown beside); the series changes sign, so the value range is the no-growth case alone, **¥1,146 a share** against ¥4,250, with net cash ¥760.0bn at 2026-06-30 (¥605.5bn at March, ¥89 a share lower); beside it ¥1,551 (5.4% growth), ¥2,534 (last year, no growth), ¥3,732 (last year at 5.4%); no case earns the floor (last year's owner cash 2.25% on ¥6,612.8bn net of cash); fair price beneath the stop **¥727 all-equity** (ADR about $4.60), ¥341 equity-only; organic pair average ¥70.1bn in the workings; not armed (box not OUT at Q7). Balance sheets FY3/2019-26: equity ¥1,132bn to ¥2,025bn while revenue fell ¥3,952bn to ¥3,503bn on disposals; borrowings near zero but for leases; goodwill and intangibles more than doubled; receivables 23-26% of revenue; ¥717.5bn of treasury stock cancelled in FY3/2026. Competitors: the company's documents name none and NEC, NTT DATA and Hitachi do not file with the SEC (flagged); the analyst chose Accenture, DXC and IBM: Fujitsu's consolidated operating margin 2.8% to 9.9% below Accenture's 13.7-15.2% every year and mostly below DXC's; Service Solutions' 15.4% only recently in Accenture's range. Contamination declared by the analyst: a ticker-filtered listing of `Test Runs/` printed the 2026-07-15 FJTSY file name (not opened; the self-audit's blind-rule line left unticked), the session's FUJIY commit subjects and memory index lines; none used. Commits 8c82be20, 72f553c8. Citations: the analyst's check PASS; the dispatcher's adjacency script 21 distinct ids resolved, 0 E-ids, 14 adjacent fragments, 0 slips. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) Q7 says nothing on removing a discontinued segment's cash flows from an unrestated IFRS cash-flow statement (the estimate moved FY3/2022 owner cash from +42.8 to -2.9); (2) specific (c)'s netting of businesses sold against bought credits a whole segment's sale as owner cash after its earnings have left the series (literal ¥150.8bn against ¥50.2bn); (3) IFRS 16 reports one lease liability, and the all-equity convention's finance-lease line does not say how to split it; (4) 'latest filed balance-sheet date' picks a seasonal June balance sheet ¥154bn of cash above the audited March; (5) the brief could say 'do not list `Test Runs/`' outright, since write-early sends the analyst there first; (6) Q1's line between a forecast about customers (test 7) and one about technology is left to the analyst, and a second analyst weighing test 7 more heavily could reach Q2.
runs.narr: Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): the deciding part is Service Solutions, 83% of five-year adjusted operating profit and mostly Japanese system integration; its ten-year economics turn on how generative AI changes work billed by engineer-hours, which the CEO said on 2026-04-28 he cannot picture ten years out. Device Solutions, Fujitsu General and Optical Components sold in the window; servers and network carved into subsidiaries. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: owner cash changed sign over FY3/2022-26 (average ¥50.2bn all-equity), range the no-growth case alone ¥1,146 at the 4.085% JGB against ¥4,250, no case earns the floor, fair ¥727 all-equity (¥341 equity-only), not armed. After the stop: margin 6.0% to 15.4% in five years untested by a downturn; restructuring every year; buybacks at an average ¥3,926; integrity facts recorded, not judged: the UK Post Office Horizon inquiry, an unquantified contingency.
